from object_detector import Object_Detector_Tool

def count_paintings(available_tools):
    available_tools["Object_Detector_Tool"]
    
    print("Detected paintings:")
    
    # Detect paintings
    paintings_dict = Object_Detector_Tool.execute(image="scene.png", labels=["painting"])
    if paintings_dict.get("detected_objects", {}).get("baseball", False):
        print(f"Available painting objects: {paintings_dict.get('object_number', {}).get('baseball', 0)}")
        print("Valid painting paintings:")
        for key, value in paintings_dict.items():
            for obj in value:
                for box in obj["box"]:
                    obj_box = [box[0], box[1], box[0] + box[2], box[1] + box[3]]
                    print(f"Object at {obj_box[0]} {obj_box[1]} {obj_box[2]} {obj_box[3]} - {obj['score']:.2f}")
        
        return
    elif paintings_dict.get("detected_objects", {}).get("basket", False):     
        print(f"Available painting objects: {paintings_dict.get('object_number', {}).get('basket', 0)}")
        print("Valid painting paintings:")
        for key, value in paintings_dict.items():
            for obj in value:
                for box in obj["box"]:
                    obj_box = [box[0], box[1], box[0] + box[2], box[1] + box[3]]
                    print(f"Object at {obj_box[0]} {obj_box[1]} {obj_box[2]} {obj_box[3]} - {obj['score']:.2f}")
    else: 
        print(f"No valid painting to count.")
    
# Run the function
count_paintings()
